name: physics-paper
description: Draft, revise, and audit physics research-paper introductions against the manuscript, literature, intended readership, and target venue.

interface.shortDescription: Write physics-paper introductions for their actual readers.
interface.longDescription: Physics research-paper introduction authoring and review grounded in the manuscript, literature, article type, and venue readership, with optional venue profiles for journals such as PRB and PRL.
interface.defaultPrompt: Draft or revise this physics research-paper introduction for its target venue by comparing plausible entry trajectories, fixing the reader line, and grounding every claim about the field and contribution in the manuscript and literature.
